maya.name: Maya Chen
maya.description: A commuter with a canvas tote and a folded newspaper tucked under one arm.

dialog.greeting: Morning. If you are looking for the library, the walk just north of here is pleasant.
dialog.station: The platforms are through the concourse to the south. The board usually updates a minute or two early.
dialog.cafe: The café is good for a quick coffee, especially before the rush.

maya.default_dialog: Maya gives you a friendly nod before checking the time.

devon.name: Devon Reyes
devon.description: The café barista, moving easily between the register and the espresso machine.

dialog.greeting: Welcome in. Take your time—there is no line yet.
dialog.library: The library is north of the plaza. They have a good community-events board in the lobby.
dialog.morning: Quiet mornings are my favorite part of the shift.

devon.default_dialog: Devon smiles and returns to arranging cups by the counter.
